stock.description: Tang Palace (China) Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company with core activities in restaurant management and food production across the People's Republic of China. The firm's extensive restaurant portfolio includes brands such as Tang Palace Seafood Restaurant, Tang's Cuisine, Tang Palace, Social Place, Canton Tea Room, Pepper Lunch, Soup Delice, and PappaRich. Beyond its primary ventures, the company also engages in holding intangible assets and conducting retail and wholesale trade. As of December 31, 2021, its operations included 49 owned restaurants and 13 additional restaurants managed through joint ventures. The company was established in 1992 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
